Definition: of foreign origin (compare H6578); Euphrates, a river of Asia:--Euphrates.
BiblicalUsage: Euphrátēs is the word for Euphrates, a river of Asia. In Revelation 9:14, the text says "Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, euphrátēs means Euphrates, a river of Asia, nothing more and nothing less.
